name: weld
description: WELD — AI Game Studio. Describe it. Build it. Break it. Ship it.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @weld/api" "npm run dev -w @weld/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @weld/gamebible --if-present && npm run build -w @weld/sample-game && npm run build -w @weld/web
scripts.test: npm test -w @weld/gamebible && npm test -w @weld/sample-game && npm test -w @weld/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @weld/gamebible && npm run typecheck -w @weld/sample-game && npm run typecheck -w @weld/web
